remarks: WELCOME to Chesterfield, Nestled within a highly sough-after gated community, this 1 bedroom, 1.5 bath condo offers an oasis of tranquility paired with unbeatable accessibility. The unit truly feels like a 2 bedroom includes a large office with French doors that can give privacy when needed also has a loft that can be used as a guest room. Inside, the spacious living room welcomes you with its expansive high ceiling and skylight, infusing the space with natural light and an airy ambiance. With a wood burning fireplace, it is perfect for unwinding or hosting intimate gatherings. The newly updated kitchen, boasting modern amenities and ample storage, stands ready to inspire your culinary adventures. Step onto the large private balcony, your slice of outdoor paradise, and bask in the soothing embrace of nature. Whether hosting friends or simply enjoying quiet moments alone, this condo effortlessly caters to your lifestyle. And when it's time for some leisure, the community's clubhouse and two pools await, and its parklike premises, promising hours of relaxation, socializing and simply walking or jogging. Just across the street from Ridgeway Center with Stop-and-Shop, Staples, Marshall's, LA Fitness and many others, AND minutes from many restaurants and the new Whole Foods. Discover the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and community in this inviting condo in sought after Chesterfield Association, a short drive to downtown and the train station.
